title: Build a CRUD API with Express
description: Kilnworth Pottery runs evening and weekend workshops from a small studio, and its places are still booked through a paper sign-up sheet by the door. Build the JSON API behind its new sign-up page with Express, one issue at a time: a first app, reading workshops, creating them from a request body, changing and removing them, then routers, middleware and one error handler. You learn how Express handles routes, parameters, bodies, statuses and errors by growing one real API.
